title: AgentHarnessState
description: One agent harness as its editor needs it: the published harness, the draft when one exists, the draft revision to send back as `If-Match`, and the resolved view for display.

harnessStatus.description: Where a harness stands. `Published` has no pending draft. `Draft` has a draft that waits to be published. `Inherited` means the persona has no harness and its members get the default. `NotConfigured` is a persona harness that has never been published and has no draft.

published.description: The harness as published, with its own fields only. A persona harness that has never been published has no `publishedAt`.

draft.description: The unpublished edits, with the harness's own fields only. Absent when there is no draft.

draftRevision.description: Revision of the draft, to send as `If-Match` on the next draft write. It grows on every draft write, discard and publish and never repeats for a harness.

resolved.description: What the draft, or the published harness when there is no draft, amounts to once the published default is applied. For display only. Edits go to the draft.
